title: Apple TV is raising its subscription prices again
slides: Apple TV hikes prices again—why now, and who leaves?
This third increase in two years hits existing subscribers.
Apple's service revenue offsets falling hardware sales.
Your streaming budget just lost another cheap option.
Cancel now or downgrade—before you pay more.
thread_text:
1. Apple TV+ just got pricier.

Existing subscribers feel the sting as the third hike in two years hits their monthly bill.

2. Why now, though?

Apple’s service revenue is propping up falling hardware sales, so they’re squeezing loyal streamers.

3. Your budget loses another cheap option.

With each increase, more viewers weigh canceling or downgrading before the next billing cycle.

4. The twist: competition stays flat.

Rivals hold prices, making Apple’s move stand out—and push switch decisions.

5. Check your renewal date today.

If you haven't decided, compare your current plan with what you actually watch—then cancel or downgrade before the hike hits.

script: Check your plan and decide now.

instagram.caption:
Your third Apple TV+ price hike in two years just hit your monthly bill.

Apple is leaning on subscription revenue to offset slowing iPhone and Mac sales, so loyal streamers are paying the difference. This time, rivals like Netflix and Disney aren't following suit—making Apple the outlier.

If you create content, that's another line item squeezing your production budget or personal watchlist. Every dollar here is one less for tools or research.

Before your next renewal date, check what you actually watch. Downgrade to the ad tier or cancel outright—or is the convenience worth the extra monthly cost to you? 🎬💸🤔
